rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Premium
rules.reason: Premium hands crush a maniac's 3-bet range, and maniacs rarely fold to a 4-bet. 4-bet for value.

rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Strong
rules.reason: Maniacs 3-bet a very wide range. Strong hands are well ahead: call and play the pot.

rules.conditions: Hero: SecondPair to TopPairGoodKicker
rules.reason: Maniacs c-bet nearly everything. Keep their bluffs in with medium pairs: call.

rules.conditions: Hero: SecondPair to TopPairGoodKicker
rules.reason: Maniacs bluff the river far too often. Medium pairs are good enough to call.

rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Strong, Playable
rules.reason: A nit's 3-bet is almost always QQ+ or AK. Even strong hands are behind: fold.

rules.conditions: Hero: TopPairWeakKicker to Overpair
rules.reason: A nit's big river bet is almost never a bluff. One pair is beaten; fold.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air; no draws; board must be Dry; no CallingStation also in the hand
rules.reason: An overfolder and no station in a dry 3-way pot: a small stab takes it down often enough.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air; no draws; board must be Dry
rules.reason: Overfolders give up too often on dry boards. A small stab prints money.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air
rules.reason: Overfolders call a flop bet light, then give up on the turn far too often. Fire again with air.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air; no draws
rules.reason: In a 3-way pot with a station, somebody nearly always has a piece. Don't stab with air.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air; no draws
rules.reason: Stations call flop bets with any piece. With no hand and no draw, check back.

rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Premium, Strong
rules.reason: Stations call iso-raises with too many hands. Make it big with strong hands.

rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Playable; no Maniac left to act behind you
rules.reason: With no maniac left to act, playable hands love a heads-up pot against a station. Isolate big.

rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Playable; left to act behind you: Maniac
rules.reason: A maniac left to act squeezes iso-raises constantly, and playable hands can't call a 3-bet. Let them go.

rules.conditions: Hero hand group: Trash
rules.reason: Stations won't fold to an iso-raise, so trash hands can't win by bluffing. Fold.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air
rules.reason: Stations don't fold. Bluffing them burns money; give up with air.

rules.conditions: Hero: TopPairWeakKicker to FullHousePlus; board not FourToFlush, FourToStraight
rules.reason: Stations call too wide with weaker pairs. Bet big for value.

rules.conditions: Hero: Air; no draws
rules.reason: A station won't fold the turn either. With no pair and no draw, check back and see the river for free.

rules.conditions: Hero: TopPairGoodKicker to FullHousePlus; board not FourToFlush, FourToStraight
rules.reason: Stations call the turn with any pair. Keep betting big with top pair good kicker or better.

rules.conditions: Stat line inside this type's ranges only
rules.reason: Nit: Plays very few hands, rarely bluffs, gives up easily without a strong hand. Ranges: VPIP 10-16, PFR 8-13, 3Bet 2-4, WTSD 20-25, AF 2-4, FoldToCbet 50-65.

rules.conditions: Stat line inside this type's ranges only
rules.reason: Calling Station: Plays many hands passively and calls far too often; hard to bluff. Ranges: VPIP 40-65, PFR 3-10, 3Bet 1-3, WTSD 33-45, AF 0.5-1.5, FoldToCbet 20-35.

rules.conditions: Stat line inside this type's ranges only
rules.reason: Maniac: Plays many hands very aggressively: raises, 3-bets and barrels with a wide range. Ranges: VPIP 45-80, PFR 30-55, 3Bet 12-25, WTSD 28-38, AF 4-8, FoldToCbet 25-40.

rules.conditions: Stat line inside this type's ranges only
rules.reason: Overfolder: Reasonably tight preflop but folds too often to c-bets and pressure. Ranges: VPIP 18-24, PFR 14-19, 3Bet 4-7, WTSD 19-24, AF 1.5-2.5, FoldToCbet 62-75.

rules.conditions: Stat line inside this type's ranges only
rules.reason: Reg: Solid regular with standard frequencies; no big leak to target. Ranges: VPIP 22-28, PFR 18-23, 3Bet 7-10, WTSD 26-30, AF 2.5-3.5, FoldToCbet 40-50.

rules.conditions: One hand, street by street, ending at station-river-no-bluff or station-river-value or station-turn-no-bluff or station-turn-value; every earlier street a rule covers is a decision too (at least one), the other streets follow the default play
rules.correct: Each decision has its own rule
rules.reason: Each decision is graded by its own rule. After a wrong answer the hand goes on along the correct line.

rules.conditions: One hand, street by street, ending at overfolder-turn-barrel; every earlier street a rule covers is a decision too (at least one), the other streets follow the default play
rules.correct: Each decision has its own rule
rules.reason: Each decision is graded by its own rule. After a wrong answer the hand goes on along the correct line.

types.description: Reasonably tight preflop but folds too often to c-bets and pressure.

types.name: Reg
types.description: Solid regular with standard frequencies; no big leak to target.
